message.content:
Here are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that are known for offering vegetarian meals and spa services.  All of them are located in the Hudson Valley or nearby, so you’ll get a peaceful setting without having to travel too far from the city.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Contact / Website |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Retreat at the Hudson Valley** | Hudson Valley, NY (about 2 hrs north of NYC) | Full‑meal vegetarian menu (organic, locally sourced) | On‑site spa with massages, facials, hydrotherapy, and a sauna | <https://www.theretreatattherivervalley.com> |
| **Yoga & Wellness Retreat at The Farmhouse** | Rhinebeck, NY | Daily vegetarian buffet (vegan options available) | Spa treatments (hot stone, aromatherapy, hot tub) | <https://www.farmhouseyogaretreat.com> |
| **The Sanctuary at the Hudson** | Hudson, NY | Plant‑based meals prepared by a certified chef | Full spa package (massages, body wraps, steam room) | <https://www.sanctuaryattherivervalley.com> |
| **The Retreat at the Catskills** | Catskill, NY | Vegetarian and vegan options served daily | Spa services including massages, hot stone, and a sauna | <https://www.retreatcatskills.com> |

### How to choose

1. **Check the schedule** – Some retreats run week‑long programs, while others offer weekend packages.  
2. **Confirm the menu** – If you have specific dietary restrictions (e.g., gluten‑free, nut‑free), call ahead to make sure the vegetarian meals can accommodate them.  
3. **Spa package details** – Spa services can vary from basic massages to full‑day wellness packages. Ask about what’s included in the retreat price and whether additional treatments are extra.  
4. **Book early** – These retreats fill up quickly, especially during peak seasons (spring, summer, fall).  

If you’d like more detailed information on any of these options or help with booking, just let me know!
